QUOTE: "Calls `client.createPost` once more, with the same single-attempt policy. ... On failure, marks the post failed again, or removes it for the same three server errors above."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that retryFailedPost makes one new attempt with a single-attempt policy and no background resend. On failure it marks the post failed again, or removes it for the same three errors.
